title: 约翰霍普金斯讲师：中美科技竞争已到董事会层面
speaker: Ellie Rostom

segments.en: Well I think the you know I've been teaching on China and immersion technology for about seven years now and when I first started teaching the question was always to my students do you think China is a is a hegemon or powerful state.
segments.zh: 我教中国和沉浸式技术大约七年了，刚开始教时，学生总问：中国是霸权还是强国？

segments.en: I think officially we can be you know I think we're officially looking at a bipolar world and two formidable countries with formidable intelligence communities who are going at each other quite frankly like this is the most stereotypical sort of you know the oldest trick in the book.
segments.zh: 官方上我们面对的是两极世界，两个强大国家拥有强大情报界，相互较量，这是最老套的手法。

segments.en: With regards to this alleged Chinese spy but I think the deeper question and the more interesting questions and policy debates is what what is the responsibility of the tech CEOs who are sort of at the home of this tech competition we should expect more of them I would love to see what Nvidia does and what the US government does in terms of any security rules around the CEOs a lot of them have security clearances.
segments.zh: 关于所谓中国间谍，更深层的问题是科技CEO的责任，他们处于竞争核心，我们应期待更多，比如英伟达和美国政府的安全规则，许多CEO有安全许可。

segments.en: So that's the you know that's really I mean he's going to be there three Republican chairs that have already asked him for closed briefings on November 18th I think it's the foreign affairs the intelligence and the China committees so we'll see what comes out of that.
segments.zh: 他将面对三位共和党主席，已要求11月18日闭门简报，涉及外交、情报和中国委员会，我们看结果。

segments.en: Yeah you said when it comes to just this overthink this overall a fair and what transpire maybe there was a sense of recklessness I think you mentioned there I mean how hard would it be to for a foreign nation or China allegedly here of course to infiltrate someone like Jensen Huang.
segments.zh: 你提到整体公平和可能发生的鲁莽，外国或中国渗透黄仁勋这样的人有多难？

segments.en: Yeah well there are a variety of ways of doing that and so for many of us in the intelligence community this is actually not surprising this is as I said the oldest tricks in the books yeah I think the you know when the where the conversation is focused now is on export controls but it sounded like this was not so much about export controls we were worried about what crosses borders but it sounds like we should be worried about who's sitting in the boardroom.
segments.zh: 有多种方式，对情报界来说不意外，这是老套手法。现在焦点在出口管制，但似乎更应担心董事会里是谁。

segments.en: Okay and what is it what can we expect in terms of export controls now I mean this is the timing of this is probably not great for a video right coming after the midterms with this democratic sweep which of course Democrats have been a bit more vocal when it comes to opposition on data centers and the like do you expect more tightening of these sort of US export controls and moving forward.
segments.zh: 出口管制方面，时机对视频不好，中期选举后民主党大胜，他们更反对数据中心，你预期美国会进一步收紧出口管制吗？
